Project Overview

A Feminine Identity for a New Beauty Brand

LABELLA is a new beauty brand concept developed for the Middle Eastern market. The project focused on establishing a distinctive visual identity that expresses femininity, elegance, and softness while maintaining a clean and professional appearance.

The objective was to create a cohesive visual foundation that defines the brand's character and provides a consistent direction for its potential beauty-related applications. The identity was developed from the ground up, with the brand name provided by the client.

Market Middle East
Project Type Client Project
Creative Direction Feminine, Soft & Elegant
Brand Name LABELLA
Brand Promise A visual identity that brings together femininity, softness, simplicity, and elegance.
02 / 10

The Challenge

The central challenge was to translate feminine beauty into a visual identity that feels elegant, soft, and professional without becoming visually complicated. The direction needed to balance femininity, simplicity, elegance, and a polished appearance through a consistent combination of typography, color, and graphic elements.

Brand Personality

Feminine, soft, elegant, simple, and professional.

Brand Values

Femininity, softness, elegance, simplicity, and professionalism.

Target Audience

The project was developed for a new beauty brand targeting the Middle Eastern market. A more specific customer segment was not defined in the supplied project information.

04 / 10

Creative Concept

Inspired by Botanical Beauty

THE CORE IDEA
The creative direction translates femininity and beauty into a visual language inspired by delicate botanical forms and elegant typography. The logo concept combines a floral branch with a circular composition, connecting natural beauty with feminine elegance.

The handwritten character of the brand name introduces softness and individuality, while the supporting typography provides structure and balance. The result brings together organic details and refined simplicity.

09 / 10

Social Media Exploration

Exploring a Potential Digital Presence

DIGITAL EXPLORATION

Nine-Post Grid

A nine-post social media grid was developed as an experimental exploration of LABELLA's potential digital presence. The designs demonstrate how the identity could adapt across product-focused compositions, promotional-style layouts, and brand-oriented visuals. The grid explores visual consistency, layout variation, typography, and color usage.

10 / 10

Final Brand Presentation

A Feminine Visual Identity for LABELLA

The LABELLA presentation brings together the logo, color palette, typography, botanical elements, and conceptual applications as one cohesive visual identity.

The project was presented to the client and approved following modifications. The completed delivery focused on the logo files. The additional product, packaging, environmental, and social media visuals serve as conceptual demonstrations of the identity's potential and were not confirmed as implemented.
